top_signals.title: Russia’s Hybrid War Has Entered a Dangerous New Phase
top_signals.summary: Julianne Smith, who represented the United States at NATO during the Biden administration, argues that Russian hybrid warfare in Europe is escalating quickly, and NATO is not doing enough to deter it. Putin is attempting to discourage support for Ukraine and undermine faith in Article 5, and NATO is responding with an outdated playbook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
top_signals.summary: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Surging Bond Yields Are Top Risk to Financial System, IMF Says
top_signals.summary: A surge in government bond yields is the biggest emerging risk to the global financial system, a top official at the International Monetary Fund said, as the IMF presented its twice-yearly report on the financial stability outlook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
